properties.source: Channel centreline drawn by hand through the main western channel (Dact el-Mayun, ~20 km) between Perim Island and Ras Siyyan, per Wikipedia 'Bab-el-Mandeb' (centre 12.58N 43.33E; Ras Menheli to Ras Siyyan ~26 km). Positions read off Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain) land; line checked to stay in water.
